releaseNotes: Fixed circuit saving so unavailable continuity readings can remain blank when the correct result status and observation are recorded.
Added Test carried out - no result obtained for every non-spare circuit, with a required observation and FI classification.
Displays no-result readings as NR and not-tested readings as NT while keeping genuine N/A fields distinct.
Requires measured continuity results for ring circuits while accepting valid calculated R1+R2 results on radial circuits.
Preserves compatibility with existing reports, backups, report locking and history.
